quote: We propose some experimental baselines using the curated dataset for empathetic response generation and compare the performance against a dialogue model trained on the EmpatheticDialogues dataset.
The aim of the empathetic response generation task is to generate syntactically correct, contextually relevant, and more importantly emotionally appropriate responses ...

The aim of the empathetic response generation task is to generate syntactically correct, contextually relevant, and more importantly emotionally appropriate responses following previous dialogue turns.

To evaluate the performance of the dialogue models, we adopted the following metrics: 1) perplexity; 2) distinct-1 and -2 metrics; 3) sentence embedding similarity-we used SBERT to obtain an embedding for the generated response as well as the ground-truth and then calculated the cosine similarity between the two embeddings.
